# The Linux tarball's lib/ (socom2-linux/lib/, scripts/make_portable.sh on Linux) -- a STAND-IN, not an `ls`.
# No tarball is tracked and none was at hand on 2026-09-25 (the socom-linux VM was off), so this list is the
# package-level closure of Ubuntu 24.04's FFmpeg runtime (libavcodec60, libavformat60, libavutil58, libswscale7,
# libswresample4 at 7:6.1.1-3ubuntu5, the version linux.yml pins) through Depends/Pre-Depends, stopped at a host
# package the way scripts/portable_libs.py stops at a HOST_PREFIXES library, read from noble{,-updates,-security}'s
# Packages and Contents indexes; one name per library, the shortest lib*.so.N the package installs.
# It is a SUPERSET of the real lib/ (a package can depend on a library its ELF never loads); replace it with
# `ls socom2-linux/lib` from a real run when one is at hand (Sprint 13 Task C6). One name per line; # comments.
